title: Retraction
description: A first-class record of something that WAS asserted somewhere and must never be asserted again. Retractions are permanent: the record is never deleted, and C9 scans every new served surface for its forbiddenPhrases and forbiddenPatterns on every build.

statement.description: What was retracted, stated plainly. Rendered nowhere; read by maintainers and by the audit.

reason.description: WHY it does not ship. Written so that a future editor who is tempted to restore it reads the argument first.

forbiddenPhrases.description: Case-insensitive substrings. C9 fails the build on a hit in any NEW served surface (see verify-corpus.mjs SCAN SCOPE). Phrases must be specific enough not to fire on an honest sentence — 'MySQL' alone would fire on a truthful account of the earlier phase, so the phrase is 'MySQL database'.

forbiddenPatterns.description: Regular expressions, for retractions that are a RANGE rather than a string (Addendum B R-19's 'any term GPA between 2.0 and 3.9').

previouslyAt.description: Where it used to live, so the removal is checkable.

supersededBy.description: The true claim to reach for instead. Empty when the honest replacement is silence.
